method: Read-only visual inspection of existing local captures, source contact sheet and existing previews; no new rendering or runtime workload

findings.leaves: Neutral silver faces and bevel orientation consistent; closed red/blue joins and open green passage show no material displacement or stray leaf
findings.caps: Correct color indicators and fixed endpoints; no anchor change warranted
findings.switches: Correct locations and colors; smoother metal and simplified rim remain enhancement differences
findings.text: Shared font substitution changes weight, sharpness and widths; separate typography work if fidelity requires

sourceFitEvidence.boundary: Original green leaf pairs plus original caps against native; not SVG error scores

nextAction: Retain current door art/anchors; use phase-aligned evidence before any later leaf geometry correction
limits: Different capture timestamps; no pose or attention-phase synchronization
No full door animation sequence or pressed-switch transition qualification
No collision, timing, sound, goal-route or gameplay acceptance claim
No new images, renders, builds, emulators, browser sessions or benchmarks
